mapper.select: SELECT p.product_name, p.unit, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM inbound i INNER JOIN product p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE YEAR(i.inbound_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(i.inbound_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.product_name, p.unit, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM outbound o INNER JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE YEAR(o.outbound_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(o.outbound_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT category, SUM(current_stock) AS total_stock FROM product WHERE del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_stock DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') AS date_label, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS inbound_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_quantity FROM v_inventory_history WHERE DATE(transaction_date) = CURDATE() GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_label, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS inbound_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_quantity FROM v_inventory_history WHERE YEARWEEK(transaction_date, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_label, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS inbound_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_quantity FROM v_inventory_history WHERE YEAR(transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_label, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS inbound_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_quantity FROM v_inventory_history WHERE DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label
